why: The revised cohesion wording made the model more willing to place internal cuts that separate identifiable heads from their modifiers, which raised H_set for very short-latency pieces (≤3 words and some gains up to ≤10) but also induced new spurious splits (e.g., breaking predicates or fragmenting enumerations) that produced many degraded mid-length examples; the net effect is therefore small and inconclusive.
lesson: A later revision should keep the gain in very-short (≤3-word) internal segmentation while avoiding a new bias that cuts apart predicates or fragments enumerations and mid-length pieces.
